description: Worked examples for offline ADK MCP get_example (scaffold kinds and common patterns).

examples.title: Scaffold an HTTP route
examples.summary: Adds src/server/routes/<name>.ts, permission, and initialize mount.

examples.title: Publish a namespaced event with a schema
examples.summary: Writes events/<name>.schema.json and events.publishes in the manifest.

examples.title: Register a background job
examples.summary: Adds src/server/jobs/<name>.ts and jobs.types in the manifest.

examples.title: Add an owned-table migration
examples.summary: Writes up/down SQL and database.ownedTables; tier 2 install runner is S2.02.
examples.snippet:
-- migrations/0001_items.up.sql
CREATE TABLE addon_acme_widget.items (id uuid PRIMARY KEY);

examples.title: Add a runtime-loaded UI page
examples.summary: Uses @kassis/host-sdk with en/fr locales and a render test.

examples.title: Contribute an MCP tool
examples.summary: defineMcpTool under src/mcp/tools with contributions.mcp in the manifest.
examples.snippet:
import { defineMcpTool } from '@kassis/mcp-contract';
export const ping = defineMcpTool({ name: 'acme-widget.ping', /* ... */ });

examples.title: Record an audit action
examples.summary: Declare the action in audit.actions, then call ctx.audit.record.

examples.title: Check whether a facade is allowed for tier 2
examples.summary: Use get_tier_matrix / get_facade; refused calls raise KADK-219.
